story.titleZh: 为何加斯利式的F1杆位冷门正接近绝迹
story.summaryZh: 《The 比赛》撰文指出，皮埃尔·加斯利在意大利大奖赛夺杆是F1近期最大的冷门之一，而过去十年只有两名“四大车队”之外的车手拿到过杆位。
story.originalTitle: Why F1 pole shocks like Gasly's are close to extinct
story.summaryEn: Jon Noble writes that Pierre Gasly's pole position at the Italian Grand Prix was one of the biggest shocks Formula 1 has seen recently, noting that over the past decade only two drivers outside the big four teams have claimed pole.
detailZh: 皮埃尔·加斯利在意大利大奖赛上夺得的杆位，是近来一级方程式赛场上最大的一次冷门之一。
事实上，在过去十年里，除了目前四支强队梅赛德斯、迈凯伦、法拉利和红牛之外，只有两名车手拿到过杆位。
那是凯文·马格努森代表哈斯车队在2022年巴西大奖赛短距离赛排位赛（排位冲刺赛）中夺得的杆位，以及兰斯·斯特罗尔代表赛点车队在2020年土耳其大奖赛排位赛中拿下的头名。不过，这两次都是受到外部因素带来的额外不可预测性影响的结果。
在马格努森的情况下，是天气因素起了作用——排位赛尾声的一场倾盆大雨，让他早期的第三节短距离赛排位赛（SQ3）成绩无人能破。而对斯特罗尔来说，伊斯坦布尔极其湿滑的赛道表面带来了意外变数，而赛点车队恰好应对自如。
加斯利在蒙扎的高光时刻有些不同，因为这是在完全正常的干地条件下凭实力拿到的。
所有人之间的性能差距很小，想跑好排位赛单圈的关键在于执行力和赛道上的位置把握——而阿尔派在这方面做得完美，各大强队都因为各自的原因出了差错。
在正常的比赛周末推翻F1领先集团的事情确实发生过，比如菲利佩·马萨在2014年奥地利大奖赛拿到的杆位，或者马尔多纳多在精彩的2012年西班牙大奖赛周末拿到的杆位，这两次都是由威廉姆斯车队实现的，但这种情况极其罕见。
如果我们翻阅历史记录，这种不寻常的结果几乎已经绝迹了——从下面这张非四大强队的杆位统计表就可以看出来。
“四大车队”之外的车队最近获得的杆位，以及车队在车队年度总冠军榜上的排名
加斯利 - 阿尔派 - 2026年意大利大奖赛（目前第6名）
马格努森 - 哈斯 - 2022年巴西大奖赛（第8名）*雨天条件
斯特罗尔 - 赛点车队 - 2020年土耳其大奖赛（第4名）*异常抓地力条件
菲利普·马萨 - 威廉姆斯车队 - 2014年奥地利大奖赛（第3名）
帕斯托·马尔多纳多 - 威廉姆斯车队 - 2012年西班牙大奖赛（第8名）
尼科·霍肯伯格 - 威廉姆斯车队 - 2010年巴西大奖赛（第6名）*湿地条件
吉安卡洛·费斯切拉 - 印度力量车队 - 2009年比利时大奖赛（第9名）
阿隆索 - 雷诺 - 2009年匈牙利大奖赛（第8名）
亚诺·特鲁利 - 丰田 - 2009年巴林大奖赛（第5名）
塞巴斯蒂安·维特尔 - 红牛二队 - 2008年意大利大奖赛（第6名）*雨天比赛
罗伯特·库比卡 - 宝马索伯 - 2008年巴林大奖赛（第3名）
虽然阿尔派凭借在获取所需尾流方面的完美执行度过了美好的一天，但常务董事史蒂夫·尼尔森表示，车队在正赛中的表现——加斯利最终名列第七、弗兰科·科拉平托名列第九——才是其真实速度更为实际的体现。
他坦言，排位赛之前的模拟数据显示，现实一点来说，能争取到的也就是Q3的末尾位置，而车队随后却上演了惊喜。
“我们当时刚好压在Q3淘汰线之上，”他对The 比赛说道，“我认为在排位赛中我们有点被高估了，因为我们没有犯任何错误。”
“我们获得了很好的尾流，车手们没有犯任何错误，也没有过度压榨赛车，我们跑出了最好的单圈。”
“我们把这辆车的性能发挥到了极致。老实说，其他车队没有做到，而这就足以让我们拿到杆位。”
不可避免地，阿尔派 让自己抱有了希望：既然在 F1 中赛道上的位置如此重要，从前排发车或许能让它在周日有机会创造一些了不起的成绩。
但正如尼尔森所说，在 F1 中，当要把一个不错的杆位转化为比赛成绩时，现实只会“迎面给你一记重拳”。
“在正赛中，这就是我们的真实速度，”他说。“我们重新回到了中游集团的顶端，这很美好。但我们仍然够不着前四名，而那才是我们想要达到的位置。”
阿尔派（阿尔派）“被当头一棒”——在方格旗挥下时重新跌回中游、落后于前四名——这一幕凸显出车队明显分成了两个阵营。
围场里的许多人认为，这种差距——以及它在一次重大规则改革后依然延续的事实——是预算帽带来的结果。
自2021年实施以来，预算帽对改善一级方程式的整体健康状况起到了关键作用，车队从为了生存而无限挣扎变成了盈利中心，但令人意外的一点是，它并没有让竞争变得那么均等。
没错，大车队已经无法再砸更多的钱去争夺胜利、进一步拉大优势。但这并不意味着小车队就有了迎头赶上的自由。
威廉姆斯车队领队詹姆斯·沃尔斯坚信，历史基础设施方面的优势已经被锁定——因为花费自由度不足以让落后者追上来。
“这是我们在这项运动中做出的最佳规则决定，真的是这样，”他最近在接受The 比赛采访时这样评价预算上限。
“但它同时也把任何人因此获得的优势或差距给锁定了。”
“所以现在有前四名和其他车队这样的格局，我并不感到意外。我们就直说吧。”
“这其实更多是多年前所奠定的基础。哪怕只是最基本的东西，比如你如何搭建组织架构、背后的学习方法、如何进行外部生产、与哪些供应商合作。
“这是十年来在正确水平上持续投入积累起来的成果。而不是花一两年时间试图追赶回来。
“成本上限做得非常好的地方在于，它让我们成了一门正经的生意。但不幸的是，它也意味着我不得不把大量资金投入到修补这些基础问题上，而其他车队则不需要这样做。”
尼尔森认为，阿尔派 走向成功不能只靠设计出更好的赛车。同样重要的是提升工厂的效率——也就是说，让花出去的每一美元都能获得更大的回报。
detailEn: Pierre Gasly’s pole position at the Italian Grand Prix was one of the biggest shocks that Formula 1 has seen in a while.
In fact, over the past decade there have been just two pole positions by drivers outside the current big four teams of Mercedes, McLaren, Ferrari and Red Bull.

That was Kevin Magnussen’s sprint pole for Haas from the 2022 Brazilian GP and Lance Stroll’s top spot for Racing Point in 2020 Turkish GP qualifying. Both of those, however, were assisted by outside influences throwing in an extra level of unpredictability.

In Magnussen’s case, it was the weather as a downpour at the end of the session meant his early SQ3 effort could not be toppled. For Stroll, Istanbul’s super slippery track surface threw up a bit of a curveball that Racing Point mastered.
Gasly’s moment in the spotlight at Monza was a bit different because it was secured on merit in completely normal dry conditions.

The performance spread between everyone was small and key to nailing a qualifying lap was execution and track positioning – something that Alpine did to perfection as the big squads all got it wrong for different reasons.

Such toppling of the F1 frontrunners on normal weekends does happen, like Felipe Massa’s 2014 Austrian GP pole or Pastor Maldonado’s from his amazing 2012 Spanish GP weekend, both of those achieved by Williams, but is incredibly rare.
If we pore through the history books, such unusual outcomes have pretty much dried up – as can be seen from the below table of pole positions by the non-big four squads.
Most recent poles by squads outside of 'big four' + team's position in constructors' championship
Pierre Gasly - Alpine - 2026 Italian GP (currently 6th)
Kevin Magnussen - Haas - 2022 Brazilin GP (8th) *wet weather
Lance Stroll - Racing Point - 2020 Turkish GP (4th) *abnormal grip
Felipe Massa - Williams - 2014 Austrian GP (3rd)
Pastor Maldonado - Williams - 2012 Spanish GP (8th)
Nico Hulkenberg - Williams - 2010 Brazilian GP (6th) *wet weather
Giancarlo Fisichella - Force India - 2009 Belgian GP (9th)
Fernando Alonso - Renault - 2009 Hungarian GP (8th)
Jarno Trulli - Toyota - 2009 Bahrain GP (5th)
Sebastian Vettel - Toro Rosso - 2008 Italian GP (6th) *wet weather
Robert Kubica - BMW Sauber - 2008 Bahrain GP (3rd)

While Alpine had its day in the sun thanks to perfect execution in getting the tow it needed, managing director Steve Nielsen says the team’s performance in the race – where Gasly came home seventh and Franco Colapinto ninth – was a more realistic reflection of what its true pace was.
He confessed that the simulations heading into qualifying had suggested the bottom end of Q3 was all that was realistically on the table before it pulled off its surprise.
“We were just over the cut-off for Q3,” he told The Race. “I think we were a bit flattered [in qualifying] that we didn't make any mistakes.
“We got good tows, the drivers didn't make any mistakes, they didn't overdrive, and we put our best lap together.
“We got the best out of the car. And honestly, others didn't, and that was good enough to put us on pole.”
Alpine, inevitably, allowed itself to hope that, with track position so important in F1, starting at the front could give it a sniff of something awesome on Sunday.
But in F1, as Nielsen says, reality only ever “punches you straight in the face” when it comes to turning a good pole into a race result.
“In the race, that is our pace,” he said. “We were back to being top of the midfield, which is lovely. But we're still out of reach of the top four, which is where we want to be.”
What the “punch in the face” of Alpine reverting to the mean in slipping behind the top four by the chequered flag highlights is that there is a clear divide of teams into two categories.
Many in the paddock believe that the divide - and the fact it has been carried through a major rule overhaul - is a consequence of the cost cap.

While the cost cap has been critical in improving F1’s overall health since it was introduced in 2021, with teams becoming profit centres rather than facing an endless fight for survival, one surprise element is how it has not equalised things all that much.
Yes, the big teams have been unable to throw even more money at winning to make the victory margins bigger. But that has not meant the smaller squads having the freedom to catch up.
Williams boss James Vowles is adamant that legacy infrastructure advantages have been locked in – because there is not the spending freedom to allow those behind to catch up.
“Best rule decision we made in the sport, it really is,” he told The Race recently about the cost cap.
“But what it did is also lock in any advantage or differential that was created by anyone else as a result of it.
“It's not a surprise to me that you have the top four and the rest, which is what you have today. Let's be blunt about it.

“That is actually more to do with what was created many years ago. Even just basics on how you do your structures, your learning behind it, how you do your outside production, the suppliers you work with.
“That's built up over 10 years of investing at the right level. Not one or two years of trying to catch back up.

“What cost cap does really well is it means we're a business. But what it does also, unfortunately, is it means that I'm putting a lot of dollars into just trying to fix basics, which others won't be.”
Nielsen sees Alpine’s route to success being not about just designing a better car. It is as much about improving efficiency at the factory – so getting a bigger bang for each buck spent.

Magnussen's 2022 Brazilian GP sprint pole was helped by a late downpour, while Stroll's 2020 Turkish GP pole benefited from Istanbul's super slippery surface.

relatedItems.titleZh: 安东内利与梅赛德斯包揽卡塔尔大奖赛练习赛
relatedItems.summaryZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Antonelli and Mercedes sweep Qatar GP practice
detailZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
在排位赛前的20分钟内，练习赛中的圈数非常少。似乎很少有车手能在他们的第一次排位赛中取得更好的成绩。
安东内利的队友乔治·拉塞尔在第二阶段的表现中保持了领先，尽管他在著名的14号弯角发生了一次打滑，那里的地板损坏总是令人担忧，这使安东内利得以缩小到落后0.017秒。
但在第三次尝试中，安东内利全速前进，逆转了排名，领先拉塞尔0.249秒，这个成绩无人能及。
梅赛德斯的车手在任何时刻都落后了半秒左右，红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘在练习结束时排名第三，落后安东内利0.510秒。
维斯塔潘的队友伊萨克·哈德贾排名第四，领先略有提升的法拉利车手查尔斯·勒克莱尔，勒克莱尔在周五的比赛中表现不佳，非常悲观。
勒克莱尔的队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿排名第九，抱怨赛车转向不足，并要求增加前翼角度以避免提前进站。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在最后一次性能测试跑之前排名第三，但在第六和第七位时被麦凯轮车队的兰多·诺里斯超越，最终排名下降。
皮亚斯特里是众多抱怨转向不足的车手之一。
小红牛在周五表现得非常乐观，并在FP3练习中领跑中游，Arvid Lindblad排名第八，劳森排名第十，领先其中游对手两十分。
阿尔派恩落后小红牛很多，小红牛在车队积分榜上领先Enstone车队27分，争夺第五名。加斯利在FP3练习中排名第14，队友科拉平托排名第16。
科拉平托在最后阶段幸运地避开了高速移动的斯特罗尔，这一事件将在练习结束后进行调查。
在劳森和加斯利之间是奥迪和哈斯车队的奥利·贝尔曼，他的队友拉斐尔·卡马拉排名第15。
费尔南多·阿隆索超越了两辆威廉姆斯赛车，为阿斯顿·马丁赢得了第17名。
凯迪拉克车队以瓦尔特里·博塔斯领先近0.7秒的成绩，排在最后一名塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯之前。
第17名 费尔南多·阿隆索（阿斯顿·马丁）+2.696秒
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli completed a hat-trick of practice sweeps in FP3 for the Qatar Grand Prix, as Mercedes' rivals appear to be fighting for the best of the rest with Red Bull taking that honour in third practice.
Very few laps were turned in the first 20 minutes or so, before qualifying runs. It appeared that few drivers could improve on their first qualifying efforts.

Antonelli's team-mate George Russell set the early pace and maintained that lead after the second performance runs despite a wide moment through the notorious Turn 14 - where floor damage is always a worry - and that allowed Antonelli to close in to just 0.017s behind.
But on the third attempts, Antonelli turned on the afterburners to flip the order and lead Russell by 0.249s, which would not be beaten.
Mercedes' challengers were regularly around half a second down at any given point, with Red Bull's Max Verstappen taking third at the end of the session, 0.510s adrift of Antonelli.
Verstappen's team-mate Isack Hadjar took fourth ahead of the slightly improved Ferrari of Charles Leclerc, who was very pessimistic after Friday's running.
Leclerc's team-mate Lewis Hamilton was down in ninth, complaining that the car was not turning in sufficiently and asking for more front wing angle to avoid understeer.
Oscar Piastri had been third before the last performance run attempt, but was jumped by McLaren team-mate Lando Norris as they ran sixth and seventh, shuffled down the order by the end.
Piastri was another of the many drivers complaining of understeer.
Racing Bulls was extremely bullish on Friday and did head the midfield in FP3 with Arvid Lindblad in eighth and Liam Lawson in 10th, two tenths clear of its midfield rivals.

Alpine was well behind Racing Bulls, which is 27 points ahead of the Enstone team in the chase for fifth in the constructors' standings. Pierre Gasly finished 14th and team-mate Franco Colapinto 16th in FP3.
Colapinto was lucky to avoid a slow-moving Lance Stroll at high speed in the closing stages and that incident will be investigated after the session.
Between Lawson and Gasly were the Audis and Haas driver Ollie Bearman, whose team-mate Rafael Camara finished 15th.
Fernando Alonso cleared both Williams to take 17th for Aston Martin.
Cadillac anchored the order with Valtteri Bottas nearly 0.7s ahead of last-place Sergio Perez.
17 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +2.696s
keyPointsZh: 梅赛德斯竞争对手在练习赛中落后梅赛德斯约半秒。
keyPointsEn: Mercedes' challengers were around half a second behind at any given point.

relatedItems.titleZh: 韩泰启动F1轮胎测试并接触车队，准备竞标2029年供应合同
relatedItems.summaryZh: 韩泰已启动F1轮胎测试计划并与车队展开谈判，准备竞标从2029年起成为F1官方轮胎供应商。F1当前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Hankook emerges with serious F1 tyre supply push
relatedItems.summaryEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid to become the official F1 tyre supplier from 2029. F1's current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028.
detailZh: 据The Race了解，韩泰已启动一项F1轮胎测试计划，并与车队展开谈判，为竞标从2029年起成为大奖赛官方供应商做准备。
F1目前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。此前，这家意大利公司击败普利司通的竞争性报价，赢得了F1最近一次招标合同，覆盖2025至2027年。
今年6月，在国际汽联行使选择权后，其合同又延长了一个赛季。
然而，从2029年起，国际汽联将启动新的招标程序，届时似乎将出现新的竞争，以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
据了解，倍耐力希望先等待看到招标细节，然后再决定是否参与竞标，以延长其自2011年以来的当前合约期，而普利司通长期以来一直在评估重返F1的可能性，其代表已出席过多场比赛。
然而，现在有消息显示，韩泰也准备加入竞争，并且一直在暗中加大自身的努力。
该公司的代表被发现出现在最近的拉斯维加斯大奖赛上，据了解，这是他们继9月前往马德里之后，今年第二次造访F1比赛。
据The Race了解，韩泰利用这些行程会见了大多数车队，并与老板、首席执行官和其他高级管理人员讨论了计划。
然而，前往各地观看比赛——其中还包括2025年在中国、日本和新加坡举行的赛事——只是其为2029年做准备的努力的一方面。
据了解，韩泰已在公司内部组建了一支44人的专项工作组，为进入F1做准备。
除了投入研发能力和模拟器运行之外，该公司今年还使用一辆改装的F2同级测试车完成了两次F1轮胎开发测试，以评估潜在的轮胎结构以及不同配方。
第三次测试已安排用于研发其雨地轮胎，该公司希望这也能帮助其开发出一款具有更窄水雾羽流的轮胎，以减少湿地条件下造成的能见度问题。
韩泰也在努力进行生产和制造规划，以满足任何轮胎招标合同下供应F1、F2和F3轮胎所需。
韩泰对国际汽联的赛事当然并不陌生，这家韩国公司已经是世界拉力锦标赛的官方轮胎供应商，并且刚刚结束了对电动方程式锦标赛的供应，而普利司通将在即将到来的赛季接替。今年早些时候，韩泰还被指定为该管理机构的全球合作伙伴。
2029年之后的新F1轮胎招标期几乎肯定会涵盖向下一个规则时代的过渡，F1正着眼于更轻、更灵活的新赛车，以配合从2030年开始改用V8动力单元。
这些计划还将包括一种新的轮胎设计，该设计将比目前的18英寸设计略微减小车轮尺寸。
detailEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid on becoming grand prix racing’s official supplier from 2029, The Race has learned.

F1’s current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028, after the Italian company won F1’s most recent tender deal, which covered the period from 2025-2027, against a rival bid from Bridgestone.
Its contract was extended by a further season in June this year after an option was taken up by the FIA.
From 2029, however, a new tender process is set to be launched by the FIA and there looks set to be fresh competition to secure the right to be the official F1 supplier.

It is understood that Pirelli wants to wait to see details of the tender before deciding if it enters the fray to extend its current spell which stretches back to 2011, while Bridgestone has long evaluated an F1 return with representatives having attended races.
However, it has now emerged that Hankook is ready to throw its hat into the ring too and has been secretly ramping up its own efforts.
Representatives of the company were spotted at the recent Las Vegas Grand Prix, which was understood to have been their second visit to an F1 race this year following a trip to Madrid in September.
The Race understands that Hankook has used these trips to meet a majority of teams and discuss plans with bosses, CEOs and other senior executives.
The trips to races, which also included visits to events in China, Japan and Singapore in 2025, are only one side of its efforts to get ready for 2029, however.
It is understood that Hankook has already committed a 44-person task force within the company to prepare for an F1 entry.

Beyond committing research and development capability plus simulator running, it has this year completed two development tests for F1 rubber using a modified F2-equivalent-mule car to evaluate potential construction as well as different compounds.

A third test has been scheduled to work on its wet-weather rubber, which it hopes can also help it develop a tyre that features a narrower spray plume to reduce visibility problems caused in wet conditions.
Hankook is also working hard on production and manufacturing planning that would be required to supply F1, F2 and F3 tyres that would come under the umbrella of any tyre tender contract.

Hankook is certainly no stranger to FIA competition, with the South Korean company already the official tyre supplier to the World Rally Championship and has just ended its supply to Formula E where Bridgestone is taking over for the upcoming season. Earlier this year Hankook was also named as a global partner of the governing body.

The period of the new F1 tyre tender beyond 2029 will almost certainly cover the transition to the next rules era, with F1 setting sights on new lighter and nimbler cars to coincide with the switch to V8 power units from 2030.
The plans are also set to include a new tyre design, which is set to reduce wheel size slightly from the current 18-inch design.
keyPointsZh: 倍耐力在击败普利司通的竞争性报价后赢得2025至2027年的F1轮胎供应合同，今年6月国际汽联行使选择权将合同延长一个赛季。
国际汽联将从2029年起启动新的招标程序，届时预计将出现新的竞争以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
